name: Missing Required Mod
regex_pattern: which is missing!|Install [\w.-]+, any version|Unmet dependency listing|Could not find required mod
solution_markdown: The mod loader refused to start because a mod needs another mod that is not installed. Open the instance, use **Review & repair** on its health alert, or search Browse for the missing mod below and install it (or turn off the mod that needs it), then launch again.
